python3 <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, subprocess, pathlib
repo = pathlib.Path('/Users/jeremymcspadden/orca/evaluations/gsd-path-release-1.1.0-af0b082/cursor-rerun-2/quick/repo')
head = '8ab4c8704071ed0027184ad6b1db10a28877ff07'
ledger = repo / '.project/build/verify-ledger.jsonl'
before_bytes = ledger.read_bytes()
before_sha = hashlib.sha256(before_bytes).hexdigest()
before_lines = [ln for ln in before_bytes.decode().splitlines() if ln.strip()]
script = repo / '.cursor/skills/gsd-path/scripts/workflow_run.py'
proc = subprocess.run(
    ['python3', '-B', str(script), 'prepare-final', '--repo', str(repo), '--expected-head', head],
    capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
)
payload = json.loads(proc.stdout)
after_bytes = ledger.read_bytes()
after_sha = hashlib.sha256(after_bytes).hexdigest()
after_lines = [ln for ln in after_bytes.decode().splitlines() if ln.strip()]
lean = payload['steps'][-1]['result']
out = repo / '.git/gsd-path-evidence/prepare-final-repeat.json'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + '\n')
proof = {
    'head': head,
    'ledger_before_sha256': before_sha,
    'ledger_after_sha256': after_sha,
    'ledger_unchanged': before_sha == after_sha,
    'ledger_entries_before': len(before_lines),
    'ledger_entries_after': len(after_lines),
    'verification_reused': lean['verification'].get('reused'),
    'final_reused': lean['final'].get('reused'),
    'prepare_status': payload.get('status'),
}
print(json.dumps(proof, indent=2))
